trackPair.whatToListenFor: 'Planet Rock', which Baker produced, is built from a drum machine, electro synths and cut-up rhythms. 'Confusion' puts New Order into the same New York electro setting: busy drum-machine patterns, sharp edits, a rap-influenced energy. Listen for Baker's production style carrying over from the Bronx to Manchester.

explanation: Arthur Baker, who produced Afrika Bambaataa's 'Planet Rock', worked with New Order in New York on their 1983 single 'Confusion'. It makes New Order a meeting point: Joy Division's post-punk, Munich disco, Kraftwerk and New York electro all on records from the same year.
